paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different levels of query complexity—Simple, Moderate, and Challenging—as well as a total average. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Simple”, “Moderate”, “Challenging”, and “Total”, in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each category, there are two bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL. The NatSQL bar for “Simple” reaches a value of 39.64, while the TA-SQL bar for “Simple” reaches 63.14; for “Moderate”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 48.60 and 32.32, respectively; for “Challenging”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 36.11 and 51.35, respectively; and for “Total”, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars reach values of 36.11 and 56.19, respectively. The bars are arranged in pairs, grouped by category, with NatSQL consistently positioned to the left of TA-SQL within each group. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
